about: Hand-off from the sound recipes to sounds.json, ModSounds and the lang files. Generated by tools/snd/build.py; edit the recipes, not this file. Nobody has listened to any of these sounds.

conventions.files: Each entry under "files" is one take: list them all under the event in sounds.json; the game picks one at random per play.
conventions.volume: Code volume per play. The file carries the loudness; 1.0 is normal. Random volume x0.9-1.0 per play where pitch is randomised.
conventions.pitch: [low, high] uniform random pitch per play; [1.0, 1.0] means fixed. pitch_per_play overrides it with exact values in order.
conventions.fixed_range: true: register with SoundEvent.createFixedRangeEvent(id, attenuation) so the server sends it that far.
conventions.hit_ms: Where the hit (the moment the sound is about) lands in the file.
conventions.contact_offset_ticks: Start the sound this many ticks BEFORE the contact tick so the hit lands on it (0 = play on the contact tick).
conventions.chair_ticks: Separation Chair only: the contact ticks t (0-240) of the operation this event is for; the server plays it at t - contact_offset_ticks.
conventions.subtitle: en_us at most 24 characters, pt_br at most 30; null = compound layer, no subtitle.
conventions.needs_patient_muffled_version: true: the patient in the chair should hear a muffled version (a later job); until it exists, send the patient the same file.

events.category: source of the refusal (BLOCKS for a machine, PLAYERS for the jar or a form, NEUTRAL for a mecha)
events.how_to_play: At the thing that refused, on the click that was refused. Debounce 10 ticks per player and per reason; the bare jar plays it on the first refused click in 3 s only, then the action-bar line alone. Fixed pitch: the interval is the message; the three takes give the variety.

events.category: BLOCKS for a machine, PLAYERS for the player's own action
events.how_to_play: When a machine finishes or an action is accepted. No random pitch (musical). Not more than once per 20 ticks per source.

To the player concerned only (send to that player, not to the level). Once a minute at most per cause; escalate by count (one ahem at the first threshold, two at the next, 12 ticks apart), then feedback.danger. No random pitch.

events.category: BLOCKS for a world alarm, PLAYERS for a personal one
events.how_to_play: A 1.0 s burst (A F A F). While the condition holds, start it again every 25 ticks; it is not a loop file (it has fades). World alarms: register fixed-range 48 and play at volume 1. Personal alarms: to that player only, at volume 0.8, normal 16-block range. No random pitch.
At the jar, when a jar with no hands nudges something (use or attack with nothing to act on). Random volume 0.8-1.0 and pitch 0.94-1.06 per play; debounce 4 ticks.
At the jar, when the bare jar tries an ability it does not have, together with feedback.refused (glug first, refused 2 ticks later) and the action-bar reason. Debounce 20 ticks.
Compound layer, no subtitle: play in the same tick as jar.glug, from the same position.

Server at t 11: two ratchet teeth as the tip rides over the pawl, the strike lands at 100 ms on the contact tick 13. Replaces iron_trapdoor.close at 13.
Server at t 17: the bounce falls back onto the latch, strike at 100 ms on t 19. Replaces the second trapdoor close at 19. No subtitle (part of the same clamping).
